card.name: Linking words before harmful effects
card.fires_on: Small linking or modal words (that, can, may, cause, with) right before a statement of a harmful outcome or risk, such as damage, risk, or serious reactions.

modes.label: Modal verb before harm
modes.description: May or can placed just before a described adverse outcome.
modes.example: this<< may>> place an individual and others at risk in

modes.label: Linking word in a disease or risk statement
modes.description: That or with introducing a condition or a vulnerable patient group.
modes.example: GBCAs increase the risk for nephrogenic systemic fibrosis among patients<< with>> impaired elimination of the drugs.

card.writes: It suppresses words about benefit, which fits a context where a harm or risk is expected next.
card.plain: It fires on small words like may or can just before the text names a harmful effect.
